Strava accepts MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio. Use ffmpeg:

ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -level 4.0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart out.mp4

Keep resolution ≤1080p, 30 fps, <100 MB and <60 seconds. Re-encode rather than copy streams, and ensure fast start moov atom for mobile upload.
